stories.title: Repair a Shattered Diamond
stories.summary: Phonar repairs a shattered diamond into a radiant diamond for Valin's Mage Bane recipe. Bring the diamond and 4000 copper. Supplied diamonds qualify. This exchange is currently unavailable until combined material-and-coin payments are supported.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a shattered diamond
steps.hint: The shattered diamond lies on the floor of the deep dragon's cavern. Supplied diamonds are accepted.

steps.text: Ask Phonar to repair the shattered diamond
steps.hint: Bring the diamond and 4000 copper. Mixed material-and-coin payment is currently unavailable; this is a service.

stories.title: Prepare Mithril Linked Scales
stories.summary: Aidon binds a dragon tooth and scale into mithril linked scales for Striker's robes. He also rewards 10000 copper; that money is a reward, not a fee. Supplied materials qualify, and this preparation service earns no separate zone achievement.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a large dragons tooth
steps.hint: The deep dragon in the caverns carries the tooth. Supplied teeth are accepted; no personal dragon kill is required for delivery.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a large dragon scale
steps.hint: The deep dragon carries this large scale. The salamander's smaller scale cannot replace it. Supplied dragon scales are accepted.

steps.text: Deliver tooth and scale to Aidon
steps.hint: The exact pair produces mithril linked scales and a 10000-copper reward. This service is optional preparation for Striker.

stories.title: Prepare Cured Hide Robes
stories.summary: Beowulf cures panther hide and buckskin into hide robes for Striker, and rewards 10000 copper. Reserve another hide for Xaves and more buckskin for the lich if following those stories too. Supplied materials qualify; this is a preparation service.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a panther hide
steps.hint: Panthers carry this hide. Striker's cured robes and Xaves' raw-hide recipe consume separate copies. Supplied hides are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x some buckskin
steps.hint: Certain bucks in the western glades carry buckskin; their separate hide spikes are not this ingredient. Beowulf and the lich consume separate copies. Supplied buckskin is accepted.

steps.text: Deliver panther hide and buckskin to Beowulf
steps.hint: The exact pair produces cured hide robes and a 10000-copper reward. This service is optional preparation for Striker.

stories.title: Robes of the Arch-Magi
stories.summary: Striker makes the robes of the arch-magi from a glowing orb, faerie dust, cured hide robes, radiant lavender thread and mithril linked scales, plus 1000 copper. The five preparation exchanges are optional history; supplied finished ingredients qualify. This final exchange is currently unavailable until combined material-and-coin payments are supported.

steps.text: Prepare an orb with the old centaur
steps.hint: Optional history; a supplied orb qualifies. The lich consumes a separate orb.

steps.text: Prepare linked scales with Aidon
steps.hint: Optional history; supplied linked scales qualify.

steps.text: Prepare cured robes with Beowulf
steps.hint: Optional history; supplied cured robes qualify.

steps.text: Prepare lavender thread with Mogoe
steps.hint: Optional history; supplied lavender thread qualifies. Reserve another raw pair for Xaves.

steps.text: Prepare faerie dust with the nymph
steps.hint: Optional history; supplied dust qualifies.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a small glowing orb
steps.hint: Ask the old centaur about orb. He needs pech rock, salamander scale, water and a tempest fragment. The lich and Striker consume separate orbs. Supplied orbs are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x some fairie dust
steps.hint: Ask the nymph about dust and bring azalea, mistletoe and ginseng. Reserve the dust for Striker rather than using it. Supplied dust is accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x some cured hide robes
steps.hint: Ask Beowulf about robes and bring panther hide with buckskin. Supplied cured robes are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x some radiant glowing lavander thread
steps.hint: Ask Mogoe about string and bring raw golden thread with cave-fisher filament. This lavender thread serves Striker; it cannot replace Xaves' raw golden thread. Supplied thread is accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x some mithril linked scales
steps.hint: Ask Aidon about scales and bring a deep-dragon tooth with a large dragon scale. Supplied linked scales are accepted.

steps.text: Deliver the five prepared ingredients to Striker
steps.hint: The full offering includes 1000 copper and produces arch-magi robes. Mixed material-and-coin payment is currently unavailable.

stories.title: A Piwafwi of Power
stories.summary: Xaves makes a piwafwi of power from an ancient scroll, panther hide, raw golden thread, adamantium and cave-fisher filament, plus 10000 copper. Lavender thread cannot replace raw golden thread. Supplied materials qualify without earlier crafting receipts. This final exchange is currently unavailable until combined material-and-coin payments are supported.

steps.text: Prepare ancient scrolls with the lich
steps.hint: Optional history; one supplied ancient scroll qualifies. Mogoe's thread service is not a substitute for raw golden thread.

steps.text: Prepare adamantium with the faerie dragon
steps.hint: Optional history; a supplied stone qualifies.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a panther hide
steps.hint: Panthers carry this hide. Striker's cured robes and Xaves' raw-hide recipe consume separate copies. Supplied hides are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a golden strand of thread
steps.hint: The mimic behind Striker's shop carries raw golden thread. The downward passage is currently open; radiant lavender thread is a different ingredient. Supplied thread is accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x an admantium stone
steps.hint: The faerie dragon trades this adamantium for mandrake, nightshade and an elk horn. Supplied stones are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x some filiment
steps.hint: Certain cave fishers in the northern caverns carry filament. Mogoe and Xaves consume separate copies. Supplied filament is accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x an ancient and powerful scroll
steps.hint: Ask the elven lich about scroll and bring tablet, orb, quill and buckskin. His exchange gives two scrolls; Xaves consumes one. Supplied scrolls are accepted.

steps.text: Deliver the scroll and four raw materials to Xaves
steps.hint: The full offering includes 10000 copper and produces the piwafwi. Mixed material-and-coin payment is currently unavailable.

stories.title: Awaken the Wooden Heart
stories.summary: Umpf awakens a treant's wooden heart with a scale amulet to make the pulsating heart Valin needs. The amulet lies in the deep dragon's cavern. Supplied materials qualify; awakening is a preparation service, not the Mage Bane finale.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a small amulet of scales
steps.hint: The scale amulet lies on the floor of the deep dragon's cavern. Finding it does not require a recorded dragon kill. Supplied amulets are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a treants wooden heart
steps.hint: One treant in the western cavern carries the wooden heart; not every treant does. Supplied hearts are accepted.

steps.text: Deliver wooden heart and scale amulet to Umpf
steps.hint: This service produces the pulsating heart. Awakening alone does not complete Valin's Mage Bane story.

stories.title: Prepare Radiant Thread
stories.summary: Mogoe consumes golden thread and cave-fisher filament to make radiant lavender thread for Striker, and rewards 10000 copper. Xaves needs a separate raw thread and filament pair. Supplied materials qualify; preparing this thread earns no separate zone achievement.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a golden strand of thread
steps.hint: The mimic behind Striker's shop carries raw golden thread. The downward passage is currently open; radiant lavender thread is a different ingredient. Supplied thread is accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x some filiment
steps.hint: Certain cave fishers in the northern caverns carry filament. Mogoe and Xaves consume separate copies. Supplied filament is accepted.

steps.text: Deliver raw thread and filament to Mogoe
steps.hint: This service consumes the pair and produces lavender thread with a 10000-copper reward. Keep another raw pair for Xaves.

stories.title: Trade Herbs for Faerie Dust
stories.summary: The nymph exchanges an azalea flower, mistletoe and ginseng root for faerie dust and 15000 copper. The dust is one ingredient in Striker's robes. Supplied plants qualify; no personal harvest or earlier conversation is required by this preparation exchange.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a small azalea flower
steps.hint: The azalea flower lies in the broad western glades. Supplied flowers are accepted; no gardener belt gate is encoded here.

steps.text: Carry 1 x some mistletoe
steps.hint: Mistletoe lies in the northwest glades near the mouse. Supplied sprigs are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a small ginseng root
steps.hint: Ginseng lies near the sooty disc in the northwest glades. Reserve it for the nymph rather than eating it. Supplied roots are accepted.

steps.text: Deliver the three plants to the nymph
steps.hint: This service produces faerie dust and a 15000-copper reward. Striker still needs the dust and his other ingredients.

stories.title: Prepare an Ancient Scroll
stories.summary: The elven lich consumes a stone tablet, glowing orb, crystalline quill and buckskin, and gives two ancient scrolls. Xaves needs one scroll. The centaur's two recipes are optional preparation; supplied ingredients qualify. If also making Striker's robes, reserve a second orb and more buckskin. This exchange records delivery, not a verified cure of the lich's curse.

steps.text: Prepare a quill with the old centaur
steps.hint: Optional history; a supplied quill qualifies.

steps.text: Prepare an orb with the old centaur
steps.hint: Optional history; a supplied orb qualifies. Striker needs a separate orb.

steps.text: Carry 1 x an old stone tablet
steps.hint: The old tablet lies beyond the pale tree, near the mimic's den. Supplied tablets are accepted; no recorded theft is required.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a small glowing orb
steps.hint: Ask the old centaur about orb. He needs pech rock, salamander scale, water and a tempest fragment. The lich and Striker consume separate orbs. Supplied orbs are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a crystalline quill
steps.hint: Ask the old centaur about quill and bring airy residue with magical sand. Supplied quills are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x some buckskin
steps.hint: Certain bucks in the western glades carry buckskin; their separate hide spikes are not this ingredient. Beowulf and the lich consume separate copies. Supplied buckskin is accepted.

steps.text: Deliver tablet, orb, quill and buckskin to the lich
steps.hint: This service consumes all four ingredients and gives two ancient scrolls. Delivery records no separate verified curse removal.

stories.title: Trade for Adamantium
stories.summary: The faerie dragon trades adamantium for mandrake, nightshade and an elk horn. This stone is one ingredient in Xaves' piwafwi. Supplied materials qualify; the dragon's exchange is a preparation service, not the cloak finale.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a small patch of mandrake roots
steps.hint: Mandrake lies in the grove near the treants. Supplied roots are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a nightshade plant
steps.hint: Nightshade lies deeper in the forest. Supplied berries are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a worn elk horn
steps.hint: Look for the horn carried by an elk in the eastern glades. Not every elk carries this ingredient. Supplied horns are accepted.

steps.text: Deliver mandrake, nightshade and elk horn to the faerie dragon
steps.hint: This service produces the adamantium needed by Xaves; a crafted stone does not complete the piwafwi story.

stories.title: Feed the Hawk
stories.summary: Offer a dead mouse to the hawk by the engraved circle. The reward is 10000 copper and the hawk leaves. The mouse's source item cannot currently be picked up through ordinary ground or corpse recovery, so that route needs repair. A supplied deliverable mouse qualifies without proving a personal kill.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a dead mouse
steps.hint: The mouse carries this dead-mouse item, but its ordinary recovery route currently refuses pickup. A supplied mouse must be deliverable; carrying it does not prove personal recovery.

steps.text: Feed the dead mouse to the hawk
steps.hint: The exact mouse earns 10000 copper and removes this hawk. Ordinary mouse recovery needs repair; a supplied deliverable mouse works.

stories.title: Feed the Swallow
stories.summary: Offer a dead earthworm to the small swallow near the pedestal. The reward is 5000 copper and the bird leaves. Its response calls it a sparrow, but use the visible swallow keyword. Supplied worms qualify without personal source history; availability returns through the bird's own reset episode.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a dead earthworm
steps.hint: Earthworms in the western glades carry the dead-worm ingredient. A supplied worm is accepted; merely meeting the worm records no recovery achievement.

steps.text: Feed the dead worm to the swallow
steps.hint: The exact worm earns 5000 copper and removes this bird. Use swallow when selecting the bird despite the response's sparrow wording.

stories.title: Prepare a Crystalline Quill
stories.summary: The old centaur combines airy residue and magical sand into a crystalline quill and rewards 6000 copper. The quill helps the lich prepare ancient scrolls. Supplied elemental materials qualify; no recorded elemental kills are required by this preparation service.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a small pocket of air
steps.hint: The air servant in the elemental circle carries airy residue. Supplied residue is accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a bit of sand
steps.hint: The sandling in the elemental circle carries magical sand. Supplied sand is accepted.

steps.text: Deliver air residue and magical sand to the centaur
steps.hint: This service produces the crystalline quill and a 6000-copper reward. It is a different recipe from his orb.

stories.title: Prepare a Glowing Orb
stories.summary: The old centaur combines pech rock, salamander scale, a vial of water and a tempest fragment into a glowing orb. Both the lich and Striker consume an orb, so their stories need separate copies. Supplied materials qualify; orb crafting is a preparation service.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a small pech rock
steps.hint: The pech in the elemental circle carries this rock. Supplied rock is accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a fire salamander scale
steps.hint: The salamander in the elemental circle carries this scale. It is different from the deep dragon's scale. Supplied scales are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a small vial of water
steps.hint: The nereid in the elemental circle carries the vial. Reserve it for crafting rather than drinking it. Supplied vials are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a piece of the storm
steps.hint: The tempest in the elemental circle carries this fragment of storm. Supplied fragments are accepted.

steps.text: Deliver all four orb materials to the centaur
steps.hint: This service produces one glowing orb. Prepare a second orb if both the lich and Striker need one.

stories.title: Forge Mage Bane
stories.summary: Valin combines a radiant diamond, a small pickaxe and a pulsating wooden heart into Mage Bane, then leaves. Diamond repair and heart awakening are optional history; supplied finished ingredients qualify. Valin and the miner begin off the ordinary entry routes and can roam into a holding room, so their current availability needs checking.

steps.text: Repair a diamond with Phonar
steps.hint: Optional history; a supplied radiant diamond qualifies. Phonar's mixed-payment repair is currently unavailable.

steps.text: Awaken a wooden heart with Umpf
steps.hint: Optional history; a supplied pulsating heart qualifies. The small pickaxe is still required.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a small pickaxe with a small hilt
steps.hint: The wandering miner carries the small pickaxe. It is a separate ingredient even though Valin mainly mentions the diamond and heart. Miner availability needs checking. Supplied pickaxes are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a radiant diamond of power
steps.hint: Phonar repairs a shattered diamond for 4000 copper; that mixed-payment route is currently unavailable. An already supplied radiant diamond is accepted by Valin.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a pulsating heart of wood
steps.hint: Ask Umpf about heart and bring a treant heart with the scale amulet. Supplied pulsating hearts are accepted.

steps.text: Deliver diamond, small pickaxe and living heart to Valin
steps.hint: The exact three ingredients produce Mage Bane and remove Valin. Supplied ingredients qualify; confirm the roaming recipient is available.

introduction: Explore the grove's linked crafting stories: Striker's robes, Xaves' piwafwi and Valin's Mage Bane. Preparation services explain their ingredients; feeding the two birds is a separate pair of requests.
orientation: Use look and exits, and meet visible people to reveal their requests. The checklist shows current supplies and recorded exchanges; conversation alone earns no achievement.
From the Homestead pond, stare statue reaches the grove's large open branch. The Solonar statue on that branch returns to the Homestead. Arrival discovers only the zone actually reached.
Touch pedestal by the swallow returns to the western glades; stare circle by the hawk returns to the inner circle. The paired soot discs respond to tap disc and link the glades with the caverns.

In the merchant branches, stare at Sehanine's statue to reach the other side. Follow the elemental circle for the centaur's six different recipe ingredients. Hidden circle passages may need discovery and opening.

The Point's north passage responds to say arrow, then opening. The inner circle's locked south passage responds to say solonor; the hawk's circle offers another route. The centaur's hidden north passage is currently unlocked.
Enter opening from the northwestern path to approach the lich, or from the other northern path to approach the deep dragon. Examine the local exits and keep the return route in view.
High tree branches can cause falls. Flight or levitation can protect you; active climbing may catch a slip. Learning a password or taking a route is guidance here, not a recorded story stage.

Some recipes consume the same ingredients. Reserve separate orbs, buckskin, panther hides, raw golden thread and filament when pursuing several stories. Supplied ingredients qualify without personal acquisition history.
Valin and the miner roam from an area outside ordinary entry routes and can enter a holding room. Check whether they are present. The hawk's ordinary mouse-recovery route needs repair.

Diamond repair, arch-magi robes and the piwafwi include coin fees and are currently unavailable until mixed payments are supported. Other listed coin amounts are rewards. Preparation alone does not complete an equipment story.

contacts.name: Phonar the bumbling gnome
contacts.description: Phonar repairs the shattered diamond in the northern merchant branches; his 4000-copper mixed payment is currently unavailable.

contacts.name: Aidon The HeartSeeker
contacts.description: Aidon links the deep dragon's tooth and scale for Striker and pays a coin reward.

contacts.name: Beowulf of the people of the North
contacts.description: Beowulf cures panther hide and buckskin for Striker; keep separate materials for Xaves and the lich.

contacts.name: Striker Moonflower
contacts.description: Striker explains the arch-magi recipe in two responses. Bring all five prepared ingredients; its coin-fee turn-in is currently unavailable.

contacts.name: a nasty looking drow named Xaves
contacts.description: Xaves offers the piwafwi recipe without an addressable topic response. He needs raw golden thread, not Mogoe's lavender thread; its coin-fee turn-in is currently unavailable.

contacts.name: a large ugly ogre named Umpf
contacts.description: Umpf combines a treant heart with the scale amulet for Valin's recipe.

contacts.name: a small scarred Duergar named Mogoe
contacts.description: Mogoe consumes raw golden thread and filament for Striker's lavender thread. Reserve another raw pair for Xaves.

contacts.name: a small nymph
contacts.description: The nymph by the southern branches trades three plants for faerie dust and a coin reward.

contacts.name: an ancient elven lich
contacts.description: The lich beyond the northern cave opening exchanges four ingredients for two ancient scrolls. One scroll serves Xaves.

contacts.name: a faerie dragon
contacts.description: The faerie dragon above the tree apex trades adamantium for two plants and an elk horn.

contacts.name: a soaring hawk
contacts.description: The hawk by the circle accepts a dead mouse and leaves. Its ordinary mouse-recovery route currently needs repair.

contacts.name: a small swallow
contacts.description: The small swallow by the pedestal accepts a dead worm and leaves. Its response calls it a sparrow; select it with swallow.

contacts.name: an old weak centaur
contacts.description: The old centaur beyond the hidden circle passage makes a quill from two elemental materials or an orb from four different materials.

contacts.name: a small little gnome named Valin
contacts.description: Valin makes Mage Bane from a radiant diamond, small pickaxe and living heart, then leaves. His roaming location may be unavailable; use valin to distinguish him from Phonar.
